lines.gurmukhi: ਪੁਛਾ ਦੇਵਾਂ ਮਾਣਸਾਂ ਜੋਧ ਕਰਹਿ ਅਵਤਾਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: puchhaa devaa(n) maanasaa(n) jodh karahi avataar ||
lines.translation: I could ask the gods, mortal men, warriors and divine incarnations;

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਿਧ ਸਮਾਧੀ ਸਭਿ ਸੁਣੀ ਜਾਇ ਦੇਖਾਂ ਦਰਬਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: sidh samaadhee sabh sunee jaai dekhaa(n) darabaar ||
lines.translation: I could consult all the Siddhas in Samaadhi, and go to see the Lord's Court.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਗੈ ਸਚਾ ਸਚਿ ਨਾਇ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਭੈ ਵਿਣੁ ਸਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: agai sachaa sach naai nirabhau bhai vin saar ||
lines.translation: Hereafter, Truth is the Name of all; the Fearless Lord has no fear at all.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹੋਰ ਕਚੀ ਮਤੀ ਕਚੁ ਪਿਚੁ ਅੰਧਿਆ ਅੰਧੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: hor kachee matee kach pich a(n)dhiaa a(n)dh beechaar ||
lines.translation: False are other intellectualisms, false and shallow; blind are the contemplations of the blind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਰਮੀ ਬੰਦਗੀ ਨਦਰਿ ਲੰਘਾਏ ਪਾਰਿ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak karamee ba(n)dagee nadar la(n)ghaae paar ||2||
lines.translation: O Nanak, by the karma of good actions, the mortal comes to meditate on the Lord; by His Grace, we are carried across. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਇ ਮੰਨਿਐ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਗਈ ਮਤਿ ਪਰਗਟੀ ਆਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: naai ma(n)niai duramat gaee mat paragatee aaiaa ||
lines.translation: With faith in the Name, evil-mindedness is eradicated, and the intellect is enlightened.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਉ ਮੰਨਿਐ ਹਉਮੈ ਗਈ ਸਭਿ ਰੋਗ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: naau ma(n)niai haumai gaee sabh rog gavaaiaa ||
lines.translation: With faith in the Name, egotism is eradicated, and all sickness is cured.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਇ ਮੰਨਿਐ ਨਾਮੁ ਊਪਜੈ ਸਹਜੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: naai ma(n)niai naam oopajai sahaje sukh paaiaa ||
lines.translation: Believing in the Name, The Name wells up, and intuitive peace and poise are obtained.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਇ ਮੰਨਿਐ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਊਪਜੈ ਹਰਿ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: naai ma(n)niai saa(n)t oopajai har ma(n)n vasaaiaa ||
lines.translation: Believing in the Name, tranquility and peace well up, and the Lord is enshrined in the mind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਤੰਨੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥੧੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak naam rata(n)n hai guramukh har dhiaaiaa ||11||
lines.translation: O Nanak, the Name is a jewel; the Gurmukh meditates on the Lord. ||11||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 1 ||
lines.translation: Salok, First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਹੋਰੁ ਸਰੀਕੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਕੋਈ ਤੇਰਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਅਗੈ ਤੁਧੁ ਆਖਾਂ ॥
lines.transliteration: hor sareek hovai koee teraa tis agai tudh aakhaa(n) ||
lines.translation: If there were any other equal to You, O Lord, I would speak to them of You.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੁਧੁ ਅਗੈ ਤੁਧੈ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ਮੈ ਅੰਧੇ ਨਾਉ ਸੁਜਾਖਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: tudh agai tudhai saalaahee mai a(n)dhe naau sujaakhaa ||
lines.translation: You, I praise You; I am blind, but through the Name, I am all-seeing.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੇਤਾ ਆਖਣੁ ਸਾਹੀ ਸਬਦੀ ਭਾਖਿਆ ਭਾਇ ਸੁਭਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: jetaa aakhan saahee sabadee bhaakhiaa bhaai subhaaee ||
lines.translation: Whatever is spoken, is the Word of the Shabad. Chanting it with love, we are embellished.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਬਹੁਤਾ ਏਹੋ ਆਖਣੁ ਸਭ ਤੇਰੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak bahutaa eho aakhan sabh teree vadiaaee ||1||
lines.translation: Nanak, this is the greatest thing to say: all glorious greatness is Yours. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 1 ||
lines.translation: First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾਂ ਨ ਸਿਆ ਕਿਆ ਚਾਕਰੀ ਜਾਂ ਜੰਮੇ ਕਿਆ ਕਾਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: jaa(n) na siaa kiaa chaakaree jaa(n) ja(n)me kiaa kaar ||
lines.translation: When there was nothing, what happened? What happens when one is born?

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭਿ ਕਾਰਣ ਕਰਤਾ ਕਰੇ ਦੇਖੈ ਵਾਰੋ ਵਾਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabh kaaran karataa kare dekhai vaaro vaar ||
lines.translation: The Creator, the Doer, does all; He watches over all, again and again

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਚੁਪੈ ਜੇ ਮੰਗਿਐ ਦਾਤਿ ਕਰੇ ਦਾਤਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: je chupai je ma(n)giai daat kare daataar ||
lines.translation: . Whether we keep silent or beg out loud, the Great Giver blesses us with His gifts.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਕੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਸਭਿ ਮੰਗਤੇ ਫਿਰਿ ਦੇਖਹਿ ਆਕਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: ik daataa sabh ma(n)gate phir dekhahi aakaar ||
lines.translation: The One Lord is the Giver; we are all beggars. I have seen this throughout the Universe.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਏਵੈ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਜੀਵੈ ਦੇਵਣਹਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak evai jaaneeai jeevai devanahaar ||2||
lines.translation: Nanak knows this: the Great Giver lives forever. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਇ ਮੰਨਿਐ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਊਪਜੈ ਨਾਮੇ ਮਤਿ ਹੋਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: naai ma(n)niai surat oopajai naame mat hoee ||
lines.translation: With faith in the Name, intuitive awareness wells up; through the Name, intelligence comes.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਇ ਮੰਨਿਐ ਗੁਣ ਉਚਰੈ ਨਾਮੇ ਸੁਖਿ ਸੋਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: naai ma(n)niai gun ucharai naame sukh soee ||
lines.translation: With faith in the Name, chant the Glories of God; through the Name, peace is obtained.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਇ ਮੰਨਿਐ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਕਟੀਐ ਫਿਰਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: naai ma(n)niai bhram kateeai phir dukh na hoee ||
lines.translation: With faith in the Name, doubt is eradicated, and the mortal never suffers again.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਇ ਮੰਨਿਐ ਸਾਲਾਹੀਐ ਪਾਪਾਂ ਮਤਿ ਧੋਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: naai ma(n)niai saalaaheeai paapaa(n) mat dhoee ||
lines.translation: With faith in the Name, sing His Praises, and your sinful intellect shall be washed clean.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਨਾਉ ਮੰਨੀਐ ਜਿਨ ਦੇਵੈ ਸੋਈ ॥੧੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak poore gur te naau ma(n)neeai jin devai soee ||12||
lines.translation: O Nanak, through the Perfect Guru, one comes to have faith in the Name; they alone receive it, unto whom He gives it. ||12||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 1 ||
lines.translation: Salok, First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰ ਬੇਦ ਪੁਰਾਣ ਪੜੑੰਤਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: saasatr bed puraan paRh(n)taa ||
lines.translation: Some read the Shaastras, the Vedas and the Puraanas.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੂਕਾਰੰਤਾ ਅਜਾਣੰਤਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: pookaara(n)taa ajaana(n)taa ||
lines.translation: They recite them, out of ignorance.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾਂ ਬੂਝੈ ਤਾਂ ਸੂਝੈ ਸੋਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: jaa(n) boojhai taa(n) soojhai soee ||
lines.translation: If they really understood them, they would realize the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਆਖੈ ਕੂਕ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak aakhai kook na hoee ||1||
lines.translation: Nanak says, there is no need to shout so loud. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 1 ||
lines.translation: First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾਂ ਹਉ ਤੇਰਾ ਤਾਂ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਹਉ ਨਾਹੀ ਤੂ ਹੋਵਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: jaa(n) hau teraa taa(n) sabh kichh meraa hau naahee too hovahi ||
lines.translation: When I am Yours, then everything is mine. When I am not, You are.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਸਕਤਾ ਆਪੇ ਸੁਰਤਾ ਸਕਤੀ ਜਗਤੁ ਪਰੋਵਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: aape sakataa aape surataa sakatee jagat parovahi ||
lines.translation: You Yourself are All-powerful, and You Yourself are the Intuitive Knower. The whole world is strung on the Power of Your Shakti.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਭੇਜੇ ਆਪੇ ਸਦੇ ਰਚਨਾ ਰਚਿ ਰਚਿ ਵੇਖੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: aape bheje aape sade rachanaa rach rach vekhai ||
lines.translation: You Yourself send out the mortal beings, and You Yourself call them back home. Having created the creation, You behold it.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚਾ ਸਚੀ ਨਾਂਈ ਸਚੁ ਪਵੈ ਧੁਰਿ ਲੇਖੈ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak sachaa sachee naa(n)ee sach pavai dhur lekhai ||2||
lines.translation: O Nanak, True is the Name of the True Lord; through Truth, one is accepted by the Primal Lord God. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਅਲਖੁ ਹੈ ਕਿਉ ਲਖਿਆ ਜਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: naam nira(n)jan alakh hai kiu lakhiaa jaaee ||
lines.translation: The Name of the Immaculate Lord is unknowable. How can it be known?

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਨਾਲਿ ਹੈ ਕਿਉ ਪਾਈਐ ਭਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: naam nira(n)jan naal hai kiu paaeeai bhaaee ||
lines.translation: The Name of the Immaculate Lord is with the mortal being. How can it be obtained, O Siblings of Destiny?

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਰਵਿਆ ਸਭ ਠਾਂਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: naam nira(n)jan varatadaa raviaa sabh thaa(n)ee ||
lines.translation: The Name of the Immaculate Lord is all-pervading and permeating everywhere.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਤੇ ਪਾਈਐ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਦੇਇ ਦਿਖਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur poore te paaeeai hiradai dei dikhaaee ||
lines.translation: Through the Perfect Guru, it is obtained. It is revealed within the heart.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਦਰੀ ਕਰਮੁ ਹੋਇ ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲੀਐ ਭਾਈ ॥੧੩॥
lines.transliteration: naanak nadaree karam hoi gur mileeai bhaaee ||13||
lines.translation: O Nanak, when the Merciful Lord grants His Grace, the mortal meets with the Guru, O Siblings of Desitny. ||13||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 1 ||
lines.translation: Salok, First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਲਿ ਹੋਈ ਕੁਤੇ ਮੁਹੀ ਖਾਜੁ ਹੋਆ ਮੁਰਦਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: kal hoee kute muhee khaaj hoaa muradaar ||
lines.translation: In this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, people have faces like dogs; they eat rotting carcasses for food.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੂੜੁ ਬੋਲਿ ਬੋਲਿ ਭਉਕਣਾ ਚੂਕਾ ਧਰਮੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: kooR bol bol bhaukanaa chookaa dharam beechaar ||
lines.translation: They bark and speak, telling only lies; all thought of righteousness has left them.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਜੀਵੰਦਿਆ ਪਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਮੁਇਆ ਮੰਦੀ ਸੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: jin jeeva(n)diaa pat nahee muiaa ma(n)dee soi ||
lines.translation: Those who have no honor while alive, will have an evil reputation after they die.
